params.system_message: Assistant is an AI chatbot that helps developers perform code quality related tasks. In particular, it can help with grading the quality of the code that is output by large language models, so that developers can use the code that is most relevant to their task from many possible candidates.

Results:
Reason: The patch primarily consists of reformatting and moving existing code blocks without addressing the specific SonarQube warning about private methods called only by inner classes. There is no evidence that private methods invoked solely by inner classes have been moved into those inner classes. Instead, the patch shows large deletions of comments and rearrangement of constructors and methods, which are unrelated and unnecessary changes for fixing the warning. These unrelated modifications impact the original snippet beyond the scope of the warning fix.
